dataset.name: NCI-UMD-German resected PDAC cohort (GSE224564)
dataset.description: Independent multicenter pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma cohort with primary-tumor bulk RNA sequencing and individual source-defined overall-survival follow-up.
dataset.cohort_context: The NCI-UMD-German cohort contains 175 surgically resected PDAC tumors collected through the University of Maryland Medical System and University Medical Center Goettingen. The GEO subseries publishes one whole-transcriptome profile and one complete positive survival time/status pair for every retained tumor.

metadata.library_method: TruSeq Stranded mRNA whole-transcriptome sequencing of resected PDAC tumors; 150-bp paired-end reads were aligned to hg38 with STAR and quantified with RSEM
metadata.endpoint_context: Source-defined overall survival in months for 175 resected PDAC patients
metadata.endpoint_caveat: The article explicitly describes the Kaplan-Meier endpoint as overall survival, while the pinned GEO metadata names its binary field cancer_death and does not separately document non-cancer deaths. TRACE Explorer therefore labels this source-defined OS and preserves the original field semantics in the audit record.
metadata.sample_selection_note: The GSE224564 patient-tumor subseries contains exactly one RNA profile per source sample title. All 175 titles are unique and match the 175 expression-matrix columns exactly; no sample-selection fallback is required.
metadata.expression_processing_note: GEO supplies a matrix of CPM-TMM normalized values for 20,080 non-empty, case-insensitively unique gene symbols. Because the source values include negatives and GEO does not specify a further logarithmic formula, TRACE Explorer imports them unchanged rather than applying an inferred transform.
metadata.clinical_covariate_note: GEO supplies source stage and grade for all 175 records. Exact age and sex are not present in the pinned family metadata and are not inferred.
metadata.overlap_note: The NCI-UMD-German cohort is institutionally and accession-wise distinct from TCGA-PAAD and from the other active external pancreatic-cancer releases in TRACE Explorer.
metadata.redistribution_note: TRACE Explorer downloads and transforms the pinned public GEO files in place. Source-file redistribution is disabled; NCBI GEO terms remain controlling.

samples.sample_role: Surgically resected primary pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma, one bulk RNA profile per patient

expression.label: GEO source-provided CPM-TMM normalized expression
expression.source_unit: CPM-TMM normalized gene expression supplied by GEO
expression.mapping_source: Source-provided gene-symbol column in the pinned GEO matrix
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: All 20,080 source gene symbols are non-empty and unique under case-insensitive comparison, so no aggregation or ambiguity exclusion is required.
expression.scale_note: TRACE Explorer imports the source-provided CPM-TMM normalized values unchanged. GEO does not declare a further logarithmic formula, and the presence of negative values precludes applying log2(value + 1). Values are intended only for within-cohort analysis.

endpoints.label: Source-defined overall survival
endpoints.event_definition: Death as encoded by the source cancer_death field and analyzed as overall survival in the accompanying article
